# JSM Integrated Services

> PSARA-licensed, DGR-aligned integrated security, manpower, and facility management company in South India.

JSM Integrated Services is a PSARA-licensed, DGR-aligned integrated security, manpower, and facility management company headquartered in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, India, serving clients across Tamil Nadu and South India.

## Company Details
- **Legal Name**: JSM Integrated Services (formerly JSMMANPOWER)
- **Proprietor & Managing Director**: Sweety J
- **Head of Operations**: Major AR Devadoss (Army-Veteran)
- **Chief Technical Officer**: R Jan Steve Daniel
- **Founded**: 2024
- **Headquarters**: Plot No: 112, SF No 122, RVS Nagar, Kottapattu Post, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu 620021
- **Contact**: +91 90808 63448 | contact@jsmintegratedservices.com
- **Website**: https://www.jsmintegratedservices.com

## Core Services (Three-Tier Model)
### Tier 1: Security Supervisors & Guards (ESM & Private)
- PSARA Act 2005 licensed security deployment
- Ex-Servicemen (ESM) officers, JCOs, and jawans
- Male and female security supervisors
- Civil aviation and industrial-grade protection
- 2-Hour Relief Replacement SLA with 2:00 AM van spot-audits
- Guaranteed police verification for all personnel

### Tier 2: Corporate & Multi-Skill Staffing
- IT, hospitality, technical, and non-technical workforce
- Factory assembly, warehouse packing, CNC operators
- 100% EPF/ESIC statutory compliance
- 48-72 hour workforce mobilization

### Tier 3: Integrated Facility Management & Housekeeping
- Mechanized industrial housekeeping (ride-on scrubbers)
- Hospital-grade environmental sanitization (NABH standards)
- Color-coded microfiber cross-contamination prevention
- Solid waste management

## Auxiliary Services
- GeM Tender Bidding & Government e-Procurement
- Document Scanning, OCR & Digitization (NIC 62099)
- CSC Digital Citizen Services

## Compliance & Certifications
- PSARA Licensed (Private Security Agencies Regulation Act, 2005)
- Home Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
- ISO 9001:2015 Certified
- DGR (Directorate General Resettlement) Aligned
- 100% EPF, ESIC, and Minimum Wages Act compliance
- Mandatory 5-day pre-deployment training
- Aadhaar + Police verification for all deployed guards

## Operating Cities
Tiruchirappalli (HQ), Chennai (OMR Tech Corridor), Coimbatore, Hosur, Madurai, Salem, Erode, Tirunelveli, Thanjavur

## Key Differentiators
- Single accountable partner for security + housekeeping + manpower
- ESM military veteran supervisory units
- Real-time digital attendance + QR patrol checkpoints
- Founder-led responsiveness with direct executive accountability
- 2-Hour Relief Replacement SLA
